dmm-2010-tiebreaker-03.prompt:
Find all ordered tuples $(w,x,y,z)$ of complex numbers satisfying
$$\begin{aligned}x+y+z+xy+yz+zx+xyz&=-w\\ y+z+w+yz+zw+wy+yzw&=-x\\ z+w+x+zw+wx+xz+zwx&=-y\\ w+x+y+wx+xy+yw+wxy&=-z.\end{aligned}$$
dmm-2010-tiebreaker-03.answer: $(0,0,0,0)$; $w=x=y=z=\frac{-3\pm i\sqrt7}{2}$; and the four permutations of $(2,-2,-2,-2)$ (7 solutions)
